articles.title: Why US oil companies will be 'very deliberate' with Venezuela
articles.mainIdea: Why US oil companies will be 'very deliberate' with Venezuela
articles.summary: Yahoo Finance Video: Why US oil companies will be 'very deliberate' with Venezuela. US oil companies are expected to invest in Venezuelan oil infrastructure after President Trump authorized the ousting of the Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro. Tortoise Capital Advisors senior portfolio manager and managing director Brian Kessens joins Market Domination to explain why he doesn't think these companies will go all in on Venezuela. To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.
